info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Disputes-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Dispute Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of utility billing disputes within the system. This endpoint serves as an essential resource for customer service teams, allowing them to access and manage dispute records efficiently. Typical consumers include customer support representatives and analysts who require visibility into ongoing disputes for follow-up actions or reporting. By providing essential data on disputes, this API enhances the overall efficiency of conflict resolution related to utility billing.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about billing disputes. You can use it to get the status and specifics of disputes related to your account's billing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve billing dispute information. Ensure that all necessary parameters are included in the request to obtain accurate results.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the billing dispute details are returned.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation related to billing disputes.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reference associated with the dispute.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the dispute operation.

state.description: The current state of the dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing further details about the operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the dispute operation.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.description: Defines the response schema for the billing dispute operations GET request.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the dispute entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the dispute entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the creation of the dispute was automated.

Audit.description: Contains audit information regarding the dispute operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the server's processing time for the request in milliseconds. A value of 0 signifies that the processing time was negligible.
